characters.name: Ramu
characters.look: A cheerful 10-year-old South Indian village boy with dark curly hair, bright expressive brown eyes, wearing a simple yellow cotton shirt and blue shorts.

characters.name: Bamma
characters.look: A warm 65-year-old South Indian grandmother with gray hair tied in a neat bun, wearing a traditional maroon cotton saree with a golden border and round spectacles.

episodes.title: మాయా మట్టి పాత్ర
episodes.summary: Young Ramu finds an old mysterious clay pot hidden in his grandmother's house and decides to open it despite her warnings. As he lifts the lid, a mysterious golden light pours out, leaving his grandmother in complete shock.

episodes.title: బంగారు రహస్యం
episodes.summary: Ramu discovers a magical glowing seed inside the clay pot despite Bamma's warnings. He excitedly drops the magic seed into the garden soil, causing the ground to shake and a mysterious vine to instantly sprout.

episodes.title: అద్భుతమైన మొక్క
episodes.summary: Ramu and Bamma watch in awe as the magical vine rapidly grows golden flowers and a mysterious glowing blue fruit. Just as Ramu reaches out to touch the magic fruit, Bamma shouts a shocking warning that touching it will make their entire village vanish.

episodes.title: నీలి పండు రహస్యం
episodes.title_en: The Mystery of the Blue Fruit
episodes.summary: Bamma reveals that the magical fruit must only be picked during a grave danger to the village, or it turns into ash. However, sparkling drops drip from the fruit onto the soil, cracking open the ground to reveal a glowing metallic box rising from beneath.

episodes.title: రహస్య పెట్టె
episodes.summary: Ramu and Bamma discover a glowing metallic box rising from the soil beneath the magic plant. As Bamma explains that the key to open it lies within the blue fruit, the fruit suddenly detaches and begins to fall.

episodes.title: పడిపోయిన పండు
episodes.summary: Ramu cleverly catches the falling magical blue fruit using his shirt, preventing it from touching human skin or hitting the ground. As he touches the fruit's key symbol to the metallic box, thick sparkling green smoke begins to pour out.

episodes.title: రహస్య పెట్టె
episodes.summary: Ramu and Bamma open the mysterious metallic box, revealing an ancient glowing map of their village. Just as they spot a secret door on the map, the ground suddenly splits open with a loud rumble.

episodes.title: రహస్య మెట్లు
episodes.summary: Ramu and Bamma use the glowing map to find hidden stone stairs beneath the splitting ground. As they prepare to descend into the mysterious underground passage, a strange shadow suddenly appears from the darkness.
